body: B-127 fixed in #58 (built, not walked): the artist-picture pass polls the music server's scan status every 2 s for up to a minute instead of giving up for an hour when the cover finder's scan is still running; a silent music server is not waited for; tests first (a scan that ends, one that does not, a silent server). The real-server effect needs VM 108 again (restart the Encore container right after a cover is found and look for the pass in the log).
